description: Call ANY clockin Customer API v3 route directly (https://docs.clockin.de/customer-api/v3). Required: method (GET|POST|PATCH|DELETE), path without /v3 (e.g. '/travel_logs', '/sap_events/search'). Optional: body (object), query (object). Use the named clockin tools for common tasks. Writes change live data in clockin.

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE
